how: One entry per version that has something to tell people. The first time someone opens that version after an update, the app shows the entry once: a title, a few lines, and a button that leads to the new thing. A version with no entry shows nothing. Shape: {"version": "2026.12.01", "title": "…", "words": ["…", "…"], "go": "/a-page-in-the-app", "go_label": "Show me"}
